_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.text: The text message limit was set by counting postcards.
beats.note: Friedhelm Hillebrand chaired the GSM standardisation group in the 1980s.

beats.name: Friedhelm Hillebrand
beats.role: Tested random messages, then postcards and telex texts, to choose how long a text should be.

beats.context: The length he recommended, and the committee accepted.

beats.text: The first SMS said Merry Christmas.
beats.note: Neil Papworth sent it on 3 December 1992 to Richard Jarvis.
Tweets were built to travel as texts, so 20 characters were kept back for the username and other data.

beats.text: Postcards set the length of a text, and a text set the length of a tweet.
